split: development diagnostic; questions derived from existing generated decisions before retrieval runs; not held out

questions.question: What selling price and maximum manufacturing cost were targeted for the remote control?
questions.target_text: Decision: The commercial targets are a selling price of 25 euros, production costs of no more than 12 euro 50, revenue of 50 million euros, and an international market.

questions.question: What are the three stages of the remote-control design project?
questions.target_text: Decision: The project will use three phases: functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design, with individual work and a meeting in each phase.

questions.question: Should someone erase a whole smart-board page when starting over?
questions.target_text: Decision: Smart-board pages should be preserved; users may erase mistakes but should create a new page instead of deleting an entire page.

questions.question: What qualities should the new remote control have?
questions.target_text: Decision: The project will design a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly.

questions.question: What screen technology was chosen in TS3005b and what was the fallback if it cost too much?
questions.target_text: Decision: Use an LCD screen for the remote for now, with rubber buttons as the fallback if the LCD is too expensive.

questions.question: In TS3005b, how would users recharge the remote and know when power was low?
questions.target_text: Decision: Use rechargeable power with a docking station and show a low-battery indicator on the screen.

questions.question: In TS3005b, where should teletext be accessed?
questions.target_text: Decision: Keep teletext available but place it in a separate menu rather than emphasizing it on the main screen.

questions.question: What material was chosen for the housing in TS3005c?
questions.target_text: Decision: The remote-control case will be made from rubber.

questions.question: Which curved shape was selected for the TS3005c remote design?
questions.target_text: Decision: The remote control will use a single-curved form as a distinctive design feature.

questions.question: Which parts and voice feature were removed in the TS3005d redesign?
questions.target_text: Decision: The redesigned remote will omit the scroll wheel and microphone, thereby dropping speech recognition; the rest of the design remains the same.

questions.question: In TS3005d, should teletext be under options or on a separate control?
questions.target_text: Decision: A separate button using the teletext sign will be used for teletext rather than placing it under the options menu.

questions.question: What average score did the product evaluation receive in TS3005d?
questions.target_text: Decision: The product evaluation result was an average score of two.
